sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hindsight 20/20 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "New assignment for ya. The driver still has someone helping him, and he knows too much to be left alone. If this shithead leaks my stashes, I'm gonna have to reorganize the whole fucking network! The lads are already looking for new spots for merchandise drop-offs and ammo storage. You need to check one of these points, it's supposedly somewhere under the large mountain in Priozersk. If the tip is accurate, you can leave the supplies there for my crew. We need Russian armor-piercing ammo specifically. Keep your NATO ammo and other junk to yourself."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Unlocks 6 hours after completion of Route Deviation

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the bunker under the mountain on Woods
- Stash the first Russian armor-piercing ammo pack inside the bunker
- Stash the second Russian armor-piercing ammo pack inside the bunker
- Stash the third Russian armor-piercing ammo pack inside the bunker

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1,650 Euros
  - 1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Peltor ComTac VI headset (Coyote Brown)
"The bunker is open? These hooded pricks could be a problem, but they're not the focus at the moment. The plan can't be changed, but I will notify the group anyway."
